text: F4 flags a mismatch between two material callouts on the drawing: the title block specifies [TB:material] as "P2207012111028", while note [L:C10] (found in zone C10) states "# MATERIAL: M.S.". Rule RQ-004 requires these to be consistent, and "M.S." (Mild Steel) is not equivalent to the specific designation "P2207012111028".
